summary: Sprint 1 Multi-Profile System testing complete. All 16 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified: profile cards with is_default badge, clickable URLs, Copy URL button (e.currentTarget fix), Set Default button, All Songs badge, profile editor with all new override fields. Master URL resolves to default profile with 11 songs via __all__ sentinel. 404 page works for unknown slugs. Account Settings slimmed to stage name, email, slug only.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIX VERIFIED: Copy URL button uses e.currentTarget correctly for reliable clipboard copy
BUG FIX VERIFIED: Profile audience URLs are clickable anchor tags with target='_blank' and underline styling
BUG FIX VERIFIED: '__all__' sentinel in active_playlist_ids returns full song library (11 songs)

NEW FEATURE VERIFIED: Profile model includes all new fields (paypal_username, venmo_username, cashapp_username, zelle_info, instagram_username, tiktok_username, facebook_url, spotify_url, apple_music_url, website, bio, musician_name)
NEW FEATURE VERIFIED: Profile fields override master account values on audience page (e.g., musician_name 'DJ Bryce' overrides master name 'test')
NEW FEATURE VERIFIED: is_default field - first profile auto-sets as default, subsequent profiles are non-default
NEW FEATURE VERIFIED: Default profile cannot be deleted (returns 400 error)
NEW FEATURE VERIFIED: Set Default button on non-default profiles works (unsets other defaults)
NEW FEATURE VERIFIED: /musician/{master_slug} resolves to default profile when one exists (returns merged data + songs)
NEW FEATURE VERIFIED: Profile editor form includes all new override fields (Display Name, Bio, Website, Tip Platform Overrides, Social Link Overrides)
NEW FEATURE VERIFIED: Account Settings only contains: stage name, email, slug (slimmed down)
REGRESSION VERIFIED: /musician/{slug} still returns all 11 songs via __all__ default profile
REGRESSION VERIFIED: Short URL redirect still works (/api/resolve/{slug})
REGRESSION VERIFIED: 404 page shows 'Musician not found' for unknown slugs
seed_data_creation: Test profiles created during testing were cleaned up. Main Stage profile set as default with __all__ playlist.
